name: Nebai
overview: Nebai was a male biblical figure noted as a non-Levite leader, identified specifically in Nehemiah 10:14. His mention occurs within the context of the sealed document in Nehemiah 10:1-27, marking him as a significant individual involved in the covenant renewal. While his tribal affiliation is not recorded, his leadership role distinguishes him among the community leaders of that time.
namesAndTitles: The name Nebai means 'thrive,' reflecting a positive and prosperous connotation. This proper name, as recorded in Nehemiah 10:19, was not given by God but carries a meaning that may imply flourishing or success.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Nebai as a descendant of Jacob, indicating his Israelite heritage. Beyond this, no further family relationships are detailed in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Nebai's inclusion among the signatories of the covenant in Nehemiah 10 highlights his role in the communal commitment to God's law during the post-exilic restoration period. His designation as a non-Levite leader emphasizes the involvement of various tribal representatives in this spiritual renewal. By participating in the sealing of the covenant, Nebai contributed to the collective dedication of the returned exiles to uphold God's commands.
